name: omatic-server-connection
description: o-MATIC Server Connection plus the core crew. One install configures the existing o-MATIC Server MCP connection (cloud default, or an operator-entered on-prem URL) and loads Probot, Fred, and Data. It does not create a Server, dispatch agents, or change authentication.

server_url.title: o-MATIC Server URL
server_url.description: Cloud default: https://factory.o-matic.ai/mcp. For on-premises, enter the HTTPS MCP URL for that Server.
